items.title: Show HN: Get your coding agent off ~2019 JavaScript, onto modern web primitives
items.titleZh: Show HN：让您的编码代理脱离 ~2019 JavaScript，进入现代 Web 原语
items.summary:
Browsers natively handle a lot of what used to take 50 lines of JS (or a dependency): `CSS.highlights` for text range highlighting without s everywhere, ` ` and showModal() give you backdrops and ideal focus management, `field-sizing` to auto-grow textareas as the user types.. (Something yesterday's ftrain post touched on [0]) Models know about some of these by name, but consistently won't default to using the platform-native solution and instead prefer the incumbent +JS based pattern. We started an effort in Chrome to supplement coding agents with this key domain knowledge and we're shipping our 1.0 today, in collaboration with Firefox, MDN, and Edge. 200+ guides (~1.7MB) of curated, hand-crafted implementation best-practices from web experts, updated as the web evolves. (Open source, obv, so.. we'll welcome your bikeshedding ;) Readable versions here: [1] I've spent the last 9 months obsessing over how to ship this as an agent skill + (Agentic RAG) CLI without blowing up your context window. (Or cedeing activation mechanics to MCP dynamic tool search). The skill description is minmaxed for activating on relevant frontend tasks. The RAG work I'm pretty proud of… originally a 500mb native stack down to a ~7MB pure-JS package, ~10ms search on your CPU. We just introduced a deterministic 'legacy-scan' (trained on 30k github repos) to identify old 'n dusted patterns that your agent can modernize. (92% avg precision on held-out repos.) People make a lot of claims about what coding agents are good/bad at. We wanted receipts, so we invested heavily in eval infra [2] to help us hill-climb, but also to identify when knowledge is common enough we can prune our guides. (Ofc, some of the things we thought AI didn't know turned out to be wrong :) We run codex/claude/agy against 200 tasks without the skill and then with.. In total ~1,700 playwright/AST-based assertions. Agents go from 55% pass unguided to 92% guided. Try it out: DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest install
 DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest search "animate dialog modal"
 DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx modern-web-guidance@latest legacy-scan ./src

If you spot something wrong or weird, give us a holler! items.title: Auditable Human-Agent Teams for Autonomous X-ray Experimentation
items.titleZh: 用于自主 X 射线实验的可审核人类代理团队
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12933v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Closed-loop autonomous experimentation can accelerate scientific discovery, but implementation effort limits accessibility. Agentic systems may lower this barrier, although sustained operation on physical instruments remains largely unexplored. Here, using coding-agent infrastructure grounded in validated scientific methods, we demonstrate autonomous synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices under evolving, human-defined objectives. Complete human-agent and agent-agent transcripts enable an audit that reconstructs decision provenance and characterizes the division of cognitive labor. Across three experiments, 61-67% of messages involved interpretation or judgment, while the share of methodological and scientific contributions increased from 46% in the setup-focused first experiment to 56-61% in later experiments. Provenance showed that 59-68% of error corrections involved multiple participants and that about half of all decisions incorporated the input of another participant. These results may guide design principles for multi-agent scientific systems and inform future agent harnesses, model training, and accessible autonomous experimentation.

摘要：闭环自主实验可以加速科学发现，但实施工作限制了可访问性。尽管物理仪器上的持续操作在很大程度上仍未得到探索，但代理系统可能会降低这一障碍。在这里，我们使用基于经过验证的科学方法的编码代理基础设施，展示了在不断发展的、人类定义的目标下对纳米粒子超晶格进行自主同步加速器 X 射线实验。完整的人类代理和代理代理转录本可以进行审计，从而重建决策来源并描述认知劳动的分工。在三个实验中，61-67% 的信息涉及解释或判断，而方法论和科学贡献的份额从以设置为重点的第一个实验中的 46% 增加到后来的实验中的 56-61%。来源表明，59-68% 的错误纠正涉及多个参与者，并且大约一半的决策都包含了另一个参与者的输入。这些结果可以指导多智能体科学系统的设计原则，并为未来的智能体利用、模型训练和可访问的自主实验提供信息。

items.title: EarthRecord: From Pixels to Land Change with Multimodal Agents over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery
items.titleZh: EarthRecord：四十年卫星图像中多模式代理从像素到土地变化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12934v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: While multimodal agents now carry out complex data analysis with tools, their ability to turn decades of satellite imagery into reliable land-change analysis, crucial for Earth observation science, remains unmeasured. Existing benchmarks fall short: they pose questions on curated images or give agents preprocessed inputs, leaving out the raw multi-sensor archives where such analysis begins. We introduce EarthRecord, a benchmark built on the raw record of 56 sites: four decades of Landsat, MODIS, VIIRS, and Sentinel-2 data, with cloud masking and cross-sensor harmonization left to the agent. It poses 238 land-change questions across ten analysis tasks, scored against withheld references from global products, agreement among methods, and visual interpretation. Two controls test what answers rest on: the closed book removes the record, and instrument pairs alter one satellite's data while nothing changes on the ground. Evaluations of twelve multimodal agents reveal that leading agents complete most analyses end to end but falter when an answer requires mapping from imagery. Further analysis shows that the record moves answers from prior knowledge to the pixels but not yet to the real change on the ground: when one satellite's data are altered, half of the right answers follow the alteration. EarthRecord thus provides a principled platform for measuring and advancing agents from pixels to land change.

摘要：虽然多模式代理现在可以使用工具进行复杂的数据分析，但它们将数十年的卫星图像转化为可靠的土地变化分析（对地球观测科学至关重要）的能力仍然无法衡量。现有的基准测试存在不足：它们对精选图像提出问题或为代理提供预处理输入，而忽略了此类分析开始的原始多传感器档案。我们引入了 EarthRecord，这是一个基于 56 个站点的原始记录构建的基准：四十年的 Landsat、MODIS、VIIRS 和 Sentinel-2 数据，并将云屏蔽和跨传感器协调留给代理。它在 10 项分析任务中提出了 238 个土地变化问题，根据全球产品中保留的参考资料、方法之间的一致性和视觉解释进行评分。两个控件测试答案的依据：合上的书删除了记录，仪器对改变了一颗卫星的数据，而地面上没有任何变化。对十二个多模式代理的评估表明，领先的代理完成了大多数端到端分析，但当答案需要从图像进行映射时，他们就会犹豫不决。进一步的分析表明，该记录将答案从先验知识转移到像素上，但尚未转移到地面上的真实变化：当一颗卫星的数据发生改变时，一半的正确答案会跟随改变。因此，EarthRecord 提供了一个原则性的平台，用于测量和推进从像素到土地变化的因素。

items.title: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
items.titleZh: 预填充训练，解码时监控：使用稀疏自动编码器进行主题监控
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12935v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Topic monitoring is the task of labelling the topic of each token in a model's response during generation. Activation-based monitors that run at generation time have so far been trained to detect harmful content and are limited to two or three classes. We introduce TopicScope, a framework for training causal topic classifiers on SAE features that assign a topic to every token, so that the label can change partway through a response. We train three detector architectures on synthetic multi-topic conversations covering seven topics. Across Gemma-3 1B and 4B, monitors trained on features extracted from prefill hidden states were able to generalise to decoding. We also found that the classifiers are robust to perturbations, losing at most 5 macro-F1 points when off-topic asides are inserted, topics are removed or sections are reordered. Ablations conducted to understand the contribution of the SAE revealed that classifiers reaching baseline performance without it were several times larger. Our findings show that compact topic monitors can be trained inexpensively in prefill and deployed during generation. More broadly, our work shows where SAEs are useful beyond safety classification. Our code, dataset and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mercity-AI/SAE-Guardrails and https://huggingface.co/collections/Mercity/online-guardrails-using-sparse-autoencoders-6ac602940468c62fefb2b9e8

摘要：主题监控是在生成过程中标记模型响应中每个标记的主题的任务。迄今为止，在生成时运行的基于激活的监视器已经过训练来检测有害内容，并且仅限于两到三个类别。我们引入了 TopicScope，一个用于在 SAE 特征上训练因果主题分类器的框架，该分类器为每个标记分配一个主题，以便标签可以在响应中途改变。我们在涵盖七个主题的合成多主题对话上训练了三个检测器架构。在 Gemma-3 1B 和 4B 中，根据从预填充隐藏状态提取的特征进行训练的监视器能够推广到解码。我们还发现分类器对扰动具有鲁棒性，当插入离题旁白、删除主题或重新排序部分时，最多会丢失 5 个宏观 F1 点。为了解 SAE 的贡献而进行的消融显示，在没有 SAE 的情况下达到基线性能的分类器要大几倍。我们的研究结果表明，紧凑的主题监视器可以在预填充中进行廉价的培训并在生成过程中进行部署。更广泛地说，我们的工作展示了 SAE 在安全分类之外的用途。我们的代码、数据集和检查点可在 https://github.com/Mercity-AI/SAE-Guardrails 和 https://huggingface.co/collections/Mercity/online-guardrails-using-sparse-autoencoders-6ac602940468c62fefb2b9e8 获取

items.title: LandslideFM: A Foundation Model Towards Unified Landslide Perception and Understanding
items.titleZh: LandslideFM：统一滑坡感知和理解的基础模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12936v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Intelligent landslide detection is essential for disaster prevention. However, existing models primarily focus on isolated visual tasks, require extensive labeled data, and lack deep analytical and scene-understanding capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LandslideFM, the first unified foundation model that connects visual perception tasks with contextual interpretation of landslides. Specifically, LandslideFM adapts to multiple visual tasks via a Source-Agreement Graduated Trust semi-supervised learning framework that leverages limited labeled data alongside abundant unlabeled data. Furthermore, predicted landslide regions provide explicit spatial guidance to a Vision-Language Model adapted through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling comprehensive landslide reasoning. To support training and evaluation in this domain, we also present LandslideVL, the first benchmark for intelligent landslide analysis, combining visual imagery and newly introduced textual prompts. Comprehensive experiments across public datasets and LandslideVL demonstrate that LandslideFM achieves superior quantitative and qualitative performance. Most importantly, LandslideFM surpasses general-purpose VLMs in specialized landslide reasoning and scene analysis. Our code is released at https://github.com/wangshanwen001/LandslideFM.

items.title: Tracing Psychometric Inference in Large Language Models
items.titleZh: 在大型语言模型中追踪心理测量推理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12937v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Do large language models represent psychological constructs internally, or do they only generate outputs that resemble psychometric structure? We address this question using a cross-persona paradigm across 14 model variants from two families (Llama 3 and Qwen 2.5, 0.5B-14B, base and instruct). Given responses on one psychological scale from real individuals (N = 272 Taiwanese university students), models predict responses on six other scales. At the behavioral level, larger variants reproduce and amplify human cross-scale correlations; amplification persists after correcting the seven-scale human correlations for measurement attenuation. We then examine whether this structure is reflected internally. Contrastive direction analysis finds geometry aligned with the human matrix in larger instruct variants, but little alignment in base variants under this assay. Across models, geometry strength is associated with behavioral amplification (r = 0.68, p = 0.008; partial r = 0.69 controlling for log size). To relate internal structure to output behavior, a matched activation-probing paradigm shows that probe slopes vary less than behavioral slopes (1.38-1.77 vs 0.52-1.53). A synthetic control shows that ridge probing can inflate these slopes; after subtracting a baseline based on a reliability proxy from another analysis, adjusted slopes remain associated with behavior (r = 0.88). We term the measured probe-behavior gap readout attenuation. These results establish decodability and geometric alignment under the tested assays, without showing that the measured directions mediate the cross-persona answers.

摘要：大型语言模型是否在内部代表心理结构，或者它们是否只生成类似于心理测量结构的输出？我们使用来自两个系列（Llama 3 和 Qwen 2.5、0.5B-14B、基础和指令）的 14 个模型变体的跨角色范例来解决这个问题。根据真实个体（N = 272 名台湾大学生）在一种心理量表上的反应，模型可以预测其他六种量表上的反应。在行为层面，较大的变异会复制并放大人类的跨尺度相关性；在校正测量衰减的七尺度人类相关性后，放大仍然存在。然后我们检查这种结构是否在内部得到反映。对比方向分析发现，在较大的指令变体中，几何结构与人类基质对齐，但在该测定下，基本变体几乎没有对齐。在模型中，几何强度与行为放大相关（r = 0.68，p = 0.008；部分 r = 0.69 控制对数大小）。为了将内部结构与输出行为联系起来，匹配的激活探测范式表明探测斜率的变化小于行为斜率的变化（1.38-1.77 vs 0.52-1.53​​）。综合控制表明，山脊探测可以使这些斜坡膨胀；从另一个分析中减去基于可靠性代理的基线后，调整后的斜率仍然与行为相关（r = 0.88）。我们将测得的探头行为间隙读数衰减称为“测量的探头行为间隙读数衰减”。这些结果在测试的测定下建立了可解码性和几何对齐，但没有表明测量的方向介导了跨角色答案。

items.title: Graph Visualizations in Prompts for Knowledge Graph Question Answering
items.titleZh: 知识图问答提示中的图形可视化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12938v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We study when and how multimodal input improves knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) in large vision--language models. Using a controlled evaluation over 1,500 WebQSP and CWQ questions and six VLMs within a fixed KGQA pipeline, we compare text-only prompting against text-plus-graph visualization at the per-question level and analyze performance changes as a function of reasoning complexity, model size, and image layout. Adding a graph image yields an average gain of 1.85 F1 points, driven by strong precision improvements on low-complexity questions (+4.65 F1). Mixed-effects and regression analyses show that these multimodal gains do not depend strongly on model scale, but are highly sensitive to graph layout: image-only settings sharply degrade performance, hierarchical Graphviz layouts outperform less organized renderings, and decomposing large subgraphs into separated paths yields the largest improvements. Taken together, the results indicate that visual prompting primarily aids KGQA by enhancing prediction precision in low-complexity contexts, provided that visual design respects cognitive and perceptual constraints. To optimize both accuracy and inference efficiency, we argue for adaptive visual prompting policies that selectively append diagrams to small, visually sparse subgraphs with well-structured layouts, avoiding unnecessary visual clutter and token overhead on complex queries. We conclude by relating these findings to a visual notation design theory, outlining how principled diagram encoding can guide future multimodal VLM prompting.

arXiv:2611.12938v1 公告类型：新
摘要：我们研究多模态输入何时以及如何改进大型视觉语言模型中的知识图问答（KGQA）。我们使用固定 KGQA 管道中超过 1,500 个 WebQSP 和 CWQ 问题以及 6 个 VLM 的受控评估，在每个问题级别将纯文本提示与文本加图形可视化进行比较，并分析性能变化作为推理复杂性、模型大小和图像布局的函数。添加图形图像会产生 1.85 F1 点的平均增益，这得益于低复杂性问题的精确度的大幅提升 (+4.65 F1)。混合效应和回归分析表明，这些多模态增益并不强烈依赖于模型规模，但对图形布局高度敏感：仅图像设置会急剧降低性能，分层 Graphviz 布局优于组织较少的渲染，并且将大型子图分解为单独的路径会产生最大的改进。总而言之，结果表明，视觉提示主要通过提高低复杂度环境中的预测精度来帮助 KGQA，前提是视觉设计尊重认知和感知约束。为了优化准确性和推理效率，我们主张采用自适应视觉提示策略，有选择地将图表附加到具有结构良好的布局的小型、视觉稀疏的子图上，避免复杂查询上不必要的视觉混乱和令牌开销。最后，我们将这些发现与视觉符号设计理论联系起来，概述了原理图编码如何指导未来的多模式 VLM 提示。

items.title: Reinforcement Learning based control of Cancer Chemotherapy treatments
items.titleZh: 基于强化学习的癌症化疗控制
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12940v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement Learning has achieved tremendous success in recent years. Extending its scope from the traditional complex games such as Atari, Go, Pokeman, and Chess, reinforcement learning has caught researchers' attention on modelling real-life scenarios. Personalized medicine and the dynamic treatment regimen are two such preliminary research fields; researchers are focusing their mindsets currently. Estimating the optimal dynamic treatment regimens from the observational real clinical data is being popularized among the researchers, widening its scope towards more advanced versions of reinforcement learning algorithms.
 This research is about a research study that focused on reinforcement learning techniques that have been approached in the context of cancer chemotherapy treatments. Primarily this thesis addresses the result of the study by means of the state-of-the-art on reinforcement learning techniques used in generating the optimal policy for sequential treatments, including the existing online reinforcement learning approaches. Thereby a simulation for cancer chemotherapy via traditional Q-learning would be presented. Secondly, the study will extend towards using offline reinforcement learning in the optimal policy generation. Thus, the proposed solution follows a data-driven approach, which works on the real human colon cancer clinical data.
 The novelty of the proposed solution resides in the implementation of an offline reinforcement learning approach by means of a model-based architecture using the conservative Q-learning and the model-based offline policy optimization algorithm. As per the experimental results and the evaluations, it was revealed that the proposed Chemo RL model caters well the problem of cancer chemotherapy treatment scheduling and serves as a supportive model for the junior oncologists in deciding their treatment decisions.

arXiv:2611.12940v1 公告类型：新
摘要：近年来，强化学习取得了巨大的成功。强化学习将其范围从 Atari、Go、Pokeman 和 Chess 等传统复杂游戏扩展到了现实生活场景建模，引起了研究人员的关注。个体化医疗和动态治疗方案就是两个这样的初步研究领域；研究人员目前正在集中精力。从观察到的真实临床数据估计最佳动态治疗方案正在研究人员中普及，将其范围扩大到更高级版本的强化学习算法。
 这项研究是关于一项研究，重点是在癌症化疗治疗背景下采用的强化学习技术。本论文主要通过最先进的强化学习技术来解决研究结果，这些技术用于生成顺序治疗的最佳策略，包括现有的在线强化学习方法。从而通过传统的 Q 学习模拟癌症化疗。其次，该研究将扩展到在最优策略生成中使用离线强化学习。因此，所提出的解决方案遵循数据驱动的方法，适用于真实的人类结肠癌临床数据。
 所提出的解决方案的新颖性在于通过使用保守 Q 学习和基于模型的离线策略优化算法的基于模型的架构来实现离线强化学习方法。根据实验结果和评估，表明所提出的 Chemo RL 模型很好地解决了癌症化疗治疗安排的问题，并为初级肿瘤科医生决定治疗决策提供了支持模型。
items.author: Jayakody Kankanamalage Chamani Shiranthika

items.title: AI Governance Should Prioritize Control and Knowledge Boundaries Over Limiting Intelligence
items.titleZh: 人工智能治理应优先考虑控制和知识边界，而不是限制智能
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12941v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The rapid proliferation of autonomously acting AI agents makes the governance of agentic systems urgent. We propose the competence circuit, summarized as IKC + KC + C, that decomposes an agent's real-world impact into three pathways: intelligence-mediated discovery, procedural know-how, and direct control. Using the canonical fast-takeoff debate as a stress test, we formalize the conditions for intelligence-mediated fast takeoff as a conjunction jointly sufficient for fast catastrophic supremacy, showing that most rely on rapid knowledge acquisition or control attainment rather than intelligence alone. We operationalize epistemic intelligence as hypothesis-selection efficiency and validate this framework via stochastic simulation on NK fitness landscapes across six scenarios spanning the conjunctive chain. An analytic bound supported by the simulations shows that intelligence-driven speedup is capped by the ratio of competing intelligence levels regardless of task difficulty. The simulations also expose a fast-takeoff dilemma: a large intelligence-driven speedup multiplier materializes only when the hypothesis space is noisy, but the absolute timescale remains constrained by the time required for capability-critical tests, so a large multiplier need not imply rapid progress. Simulations also indicate that institutional chokepoints disproportionately slow down superintelligent agents when mandatory authorization delays are large relative to the negligible time these agents spend on unproductive search. We argue that the dominant safety levers are restricting control and enforcing knowledge boundaries rather than limiting intelligence alone, and this applies to agentic systems at any capability level. Purely digital domains weaken these bottlenecks, strengthening the case for architectures that intentionally "put physics in the loop."

arXiv:2611.12941v1 公告类型：新
摘要：自主行动的人工智能代理的快速扩散使得代理系统的治理变得紧迫。我们提出了能力回路，概括为 IKC + KC + C，它将智能体对现实世界的影响分解为三个途径：智力介导的发现、程序性知识和直接控制。使用典型的快速起飞辩论作为压力测试，我们将智力介导的快速起飞的条件形式化为足以实现快速灾难性霸权的联合，这表明大多数人依赖于快速知识获取或控制实现，而不仅仅是智力。我们将认知智能作为假设选择效率进行操作，并通过跨连接链的六个场景的 NK 适应度景观的随机模拟来验证该框架。模拟支持的分析界限表明，无论任务难度如何，智力驱动的加速都受到竞争智力水平比率的限制。模拟还暴露了一个快速起飞的困境：只有当假设空间有噪声时，大型智能驱动的加速乘数才会实现，但绝对时间尺度仍然受到能力关键测试所需时间的限制，因此大乘数不一定意味着快速进展。模拟还表明，当强制授权延迟相对于这些智能体花在无效搜索上的时间可以忽略不计时较大时，机构阻塞点会不成比例地减慢超级智能智能体的速度。我们认为，主要的安全杠杆是限制控制和强制知识边界，而不是仅仅限制智能，这适用于任何能力级别的代理系统。纯数字领域削弱了这些瓶颈，强化了有意“将物理纳入循环”的架构的理由。

items.title: Tabular Foundation Models vs Tuned Gradient Boosting for Telecom Churn: A Profit- and Calibration-Aware Evaluation
items.titleZh: 电信流失的表格基础模型与调整梯度提升：利润和校准意识评估
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12942v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) predict from a labelled context in a single forward pass. A recent benchmark reported that they decisively outperform tree ensembles for customer churn, but it compared them with untuned gradient-boosted trees (GBDTs) and scored only ranking metrics, while a retention campaign is judged in money. We re-evaluate TabPFN-2.5, TabPFN-3.5, TabPFN-3.5-Fast and TabICL v2 against Optuna-tuned GBDTs on five public telecom churn datasets over 10 seeded splits. We separate three questions: whether a model ranks churners well, whether that ranking earns more expected maximum profit (EMP), and whether its probabilities can drive a threshold policy. With a split-aware test and Holm correction over 20 pre-declared comparisons, TabPFN-3.5 earns significantly more EMP than the best tuned GBDT on Cell2Cell (1.9%) and Iranian (7.6%), and these two gains also hold against each of the three tuned GBDTs separately. On Orange it is ahead in all 10 splits (14.3%), but the gain is not significant after correction (Holm p = 0.155). The splits resample the same datasets, so these results do not stand for independent operators. TabICL v2, the earlier benchmark's leader, beats the best tuned GBDT only on Iranian, not all three of them, and underpredicts Orange churn by 2.1 points on a 7.3% base rate. On the datasets and splits where we tested them, a substantially larger tuning budget and a duplicate-aware split leave the main conclusions unchanged. Retuning the baseline cuts the earlier headline gap from 6.1 to 4.0 PR-AUC points without closing it. The licence of the TabPFN-3.5 weights we used (License v1.0), not scoring cost, is what stands between its gains and production use.

摘要：表格基础模型（TFM）在单次前向传递中根据标记上下文进行预测。最近的一项基准测试报告称，它们在客户流失方面明显优于树集成，但它将它们与未调整梯度提升树（GBDT）进行了比较，并且仅对排名指标进行了评分，而保留活动则以金钱来衡量。我们在超过 10 个种子分割的 5 个公共电信流失数据集上针对经过 Optuna 调整的 GBDT 重新评估 TabPFN-2.5、TabPFN-3.5、TabPFN-3.5-Fast 和 TabICL v2。我们将三个问题分开：模型是否能够很好地对流失者进行排名，该排名是否能够获得更多的预期最大利润 (EMP)，以及其概率是否可以驱动阈值策略。通过超过 20 次预先声明的比较的 split-aware 测试和 Holm 校正，TabPFN-3.5 获得的 EMP 明显高于 Cell2Cell（1.9％）和伊朗（7.6％）上最佳调整的 GBDT，并且这两个增益也分别与三个调整的 GBDT 中的每一个保持一致。在 Orange 上，它在所有 10 个分割中都领先 (14.3%)，但校正后增益并不显着 (Holm p = 0.155)。分割对相同的数据集重新采样，因此这些结果并不代表独立的运算符。 TabICL v2 是早期基准测试的领先者，仅在伊朗语方面（而不是全部三个）击败了最佳调整的 GBDT，并且以 7.3% 的基准率将 Orange 流失率低估了 2.1 个百分点。在我们测试的数据集和分割上，更大的调整预算和重复感知分割使主要结论保持不变。重新调整基线将之前的总体差距从 6.1 点缩小到 4.0 点 PR-AUC 点，但没有缩小。我们使用的 TabPFN-3.5 权重的许可证（许可证 v1.0），而不是评分成本，是其收益和生产使用之间的障碍。

items.title: SetPrint: Black-Box LLM Fingerprinting via Setwise Correspondence of Response Changes
items.titleZh: SetPrint：通过响应变化的 Setwise 对应关系进行黑盒 LLM 指纹识别
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12950v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Black-box LLM fingerprinting aims to determine whether a target model was derived from a source model when only the output responses to input queries are observable. One way to reveal this relationship is to perturb each query and observe the resulting responses of both models, yielding two corresponding sets of response variations. These sets provide two complementary sources of information: the relations among response changes within each set, and the correspondence of response changes between the two sets. Existing approaches, however, have not fully exploited both. We introduce \textbf{SetPrint}, a training-free method that jointly captures both within-set relations and between-set correspondence. SetPrint expresses each response change relative to the mean change of its own set, and then compares changes from the two models that were induced by the same perturbation. On LeaFBench, SetPrint consistently outperforms existing training-free black-box fingerprinting methods. Further analyses attribute these gains to both within-set relations and between-set correspondence.

arXiv:2611.12950v1 公告类型：新
摘要：黑盒 LLM 指纹识别旨在仅可观察对输入查询的输出响应时确定目标模型是否源自源模型。揭示这种关系的一种方法是扰乱每个查询并观察两个模型的结果响应，从而产生两组相应的响应变化。这些集合提供了两个互补的信息源：每个集合内响应变化之间的关系，以及两个集合之间响应变化的对应关系。然而，现有方法尚未充分利用这两者。我们引入了 \textbf{SetPrint}，这是一种无需训练的方法，可以联合捕获集合内关系和集合间对应关系。 SetPrint 表示相对于其自身集合的平均变化的每个响应变化，然后比较由相同扰动引起的两个模型的变化。在 LeaFBench 上，SetPrint 始终优于现有的免训练黑盒指纹识别方法。进一步的分析将这些收益归因于集合内关系和集合间对应关系。

items.title: Agent Architecture Cost-Success Trade-offs: A Controlled Evaluation across Enterprise-Style SOPs
items.titleZh: 代理架构成本与成功的权衡：跨企业式 SOP 的受控评估
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12953v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Enterprises increasingly use large language model agents to execute standard operating procedures (SOPs): long, branching, tool-intensive workflows. Yet there is little controlled evidence for choosing among competing agentic architectures. Holding the model, tasks, and tools fixed and varying only the architecture, we compare four designs (a function-calling single agent, a skill-augmented agent, centralized multi-agent orchestration, and a triage swarm; eight arms) across 13 enterprise SOPs, and introduce a skill-definition quality rubric to build matched high and low-quality skill corpora. Three takeaways emerge. (1)~\textbf{There is no universal best architecture; the right choice is SOP-dependent.} On a given SOP, task success ranges from under $10\%$ on the hardest to near $100\%$ on the easiest; no architecture is statistically separable in aggregate, and added structure only plausibly pays off on complex, branching SOPs (a directional, not yet significant, trend). (2)~\textbf{Added architecture cost must be justified by a task-success gain.} Every coordinated arm (multi-agent or skill-augmented) spends $1.4$--$4.7\times$ the tokens and $2.6$--$5.8\times$ the latency of the single agent for gains that are usually small and rarely significant, making the single agent the efficient default; high-quality skills do lift success (to $73.1\%$ from $67.4\%$) while degraded skills fall below it. (3)~\textbf{Implementation quality outweighs the single- versus multi-agent choice.} A plausible multi-agent implementation loses to the single agent, yet a targeted redesign of it becomes the only arm to significantly beat the baseline ($75.6\%$ vs.\ $67.4\%$).

摘要：企业越来越多地使用大型语言模型代理来执行标准操作程序 (SOP)：长、分支、工具密集型工作流程。然而，几乎没有受控证据来支持在竞争性代理架构中进行选择。保持模型、任务和工具固定并仅改变架构，我们比较了 13 个企业 SOP 中的四种设计（功能调用单代理、技能增强代理、集中式多代理编排和分类群；八个臂），并引入了技能定义质量规则来构建匹配的高质量和低质量技能语料库。出现了三个要点。 (1)~\textbf{不存在通用的最佳架构；正确的选择取决于 SOP。} 在给定的 SOP 上，任务成功率从最难的不到 $10\%$ 到最简单的接近 $100\%$；没有任何架构在统计上总体上是可分离的，并且添加的结构只能在复杂的、分支的 SOP 上获得合理的回报（一种有方向的、尚未显着的趋势）。 (2)~\textbf{增加的架构成本必须通过任务成功增益来证明是合理的。}每个协调臂（多智能体或技能增强型）花费 1.4$--4.7\times$ 代币和 $2.6$--$5.8\times$ 单个智能体的延迟来获得通常很小且很少显着的收益，从而使单个智能体成为有效的默认值；高品质技能确实会提升成功（从 $67.4\%$ 升至 $73.1\%$），而低质量技能则会低于成功。 (3)~\textbf{实施质量胜过单智能体与多智能体的选择。}看似合理的多智能体实施输给了单智能体，但对其进行有针对性的重新设计成为唯一显着超过基线的手臂（$75.6\%$ vs.\ $67.4\%$）。

items.title: Physics2Weight: Direct Neural Network Architecture and Weight Generation from Physical Laws Using Large Language Models
items.titleZh: Physics2Weight：使用大型语言模型根据物理定律生成直接神经网络架构和权重
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12954v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled weight-space programming (WSP), which directly generates neural network weights without gradient-based optimization. However, extending WSP to physical problems remains challenging, particularly in achieving both solution accuracy and physical consistency. In this paper, we propose Physics2Weight (PtW), a framework that extends WSP to solving partial differential equations by directly generating neural network weights and editing architectures based on governing equations and initial and boundary conditions. PtW introduces physics-constrained prompting and physics-guided architecture editing, combined with iterative weight refinement from WSP, to improve solution accuracy and physical consistency without gradient-based optimization. Experiments on four PDEs, namely the heat, advection, Burgers', and Allen--Cahn equations, demonstrate lower solution errors than conventional physics-informed neural networks, while revealing limitations in satisfying the governing equations for nonlinear PDEs.

arXiv:2611.12954v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使得权重空间编程（WSP）成为可能，它可以直接生成神经网络权重，而无需基于梯度的优化。然而，将 WSP 扩展到物理问题仍然具有挑战性，特别是在实现解决方案准确性和物理一致性方面。在本文中，我们提出了Physics2Weight (PtW)，这是一个框架，通过直接生成神经网络权重和基于控制方程以及初始和边界条件编辑架构，将 WSP 扩展到求解偏微分方程。 PtW 引入了物理约束提示和物理引导架构编辑，并结合 WSP 的迭代权重细化，无需基于梯度的优化即可提高解算精度和物理一致性。对四种偏微分方程（即热方程、平流方程、伯格斯方程和艾伦-卡恩方程）的实验表明，其解误差比传统的物理信息神经网络更低，同时揭示了满足非线性偏微分方程控制方程的局限性。

items.title: Embodied Science Agents: Making Embodied Experimental Design Learnable
items.titleZh: 具身科学代理：让具身实验设计变得可学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12958v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Recent advances in large models have accelerated AI for Science toward agentic science, where AI agents autonomously conduct scientific discovery. Realising this vision requires closing the loop between computational reasoning and physical experimentation, positioning self-driving laboratories (SDLs) as critical enablers. However, existing SDLs exhibit a fundamental paradox: foundation model integration has increased linguistic sophistication while severing physical grounding. By treating models as disembodied planners that output symbolic workflows for separate robotic systems, current architectures inherently block the development of embodied experimental intuition. We argue that overcoming this paradox requires embedding \emph{learnability} along three interdependent axes: cognitive learnability (learning what to investigate), experimental learnability (learning where to search), and embodied learnability (learning how to act). Building on this view, we introduce the Embodied Science Agent (ESA), which unifies digital intelligence with physical embodiment through three synergistic components: a Digital Agent that provides cognitive and experimental learnability via memory-based reasoning and Bayesian optimisation, an Embodied Agent that provides embodied learnability via generalisable instrument control, and an Embodied Unified Interface for seamless coordination. We validated ESA in autonomous wastewater treatment experiments, navigating over 200 million possible conditions. Through 15 continuous rounds, ESA raised the final solution transmittance from 82\% to 99.7\%, corresponding to a 98.5\% reduction in residual dye concentration and near-complete decolourisation, while its learned visuomotor policies generalised across varying instrument placements, a promising step toward next-generation SDLs for autonomous scientific discovery.

摘要：大型模型的最新进展加速了科学人工智能向代理科学的发展，其中人工智能代理自主地进行科学发现。实现这一愿景需要关闭​​计算推理和物理实验之间的循环，将自动驾驶实验室 (SDL) 定位为关键推动者。然而，现有的 SDL 表现出一个基本的悖论：基础模型集成提高了语言的复杂性，同时切断了物理基础。通过将模型视为无形的规划器，为单独的机器人系统输出符号工作流程，当前的架构本质上阻碍了具体实验直觉的发展。我们认为，克服这一悖论需要沿着三个相互依赖的轴嵌入\emph{学习性}：认知学习性（学习研究什么）、实验学习性（学习在哪里搜索）和体现学习性（学习如何行动）。基于这一观点，我们引入了体现科学代理（ESA），它通过三个协同组件将数字智能与物理体现统一起来：数字代理通过基于记忆的推理和贝叶斯优化提供认知和实验可学习性，体现代理通过通用仪器控制提供体现学习性，以及用于无缝协调的体现统一接口。我们在自主废水处理实验中验证了 ESA，应对了 2 亿多种可能的情况。通过连续 15 轮，ESA 将最终溶液的透射率从 82% 提高到 99.7%，相当于残留染料浓度降低了 98.5%，并且几乎完全脱色，同时其学到的视觉运动策略在不同的仪器放置中得到推广，这是朝着用于自主科学发现的下一代 SDL 迈出的有希望的一步。

items.title: Monitoring One Channel Is Not Communication Control: Causal Evidence for Adaptive Reallocation of Joint Message--Route Codes
items.titleZh: 监控一个通道不是通信控制：联合消息自适应重新分配的因果证据——路由代码
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12959v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Monitoring a visible channel can change how learned agents communicate without removing why communication is useful. We test this distinction in an end-to-end game where a sender and receiver learn a discrete protocol and route policy without communication supervision. In two independent 20-seed batches, 20/20 and 19/20 protocols form. Online partial coverage increases shadow-route share over no monitoring by .701 [.574,.826] and .575 [.412,.737], while task accuracy remains .905/.913 and signed frozen message contribution remains .592/.563. Complete coverage removes most selective migration without removing communication. Frozen interventions, including a fresh pre-outcome confirmation, show that route is semantic: joint message--route shuffling changes .668 of receiver predictions and route alone retains .388 accuracy versus .25 chance. A corrected explicit-silence cost makes 18/20 policies fully silent and lowers mean sending to .050, but its strict complete-suppression gate fails because two seeds retain communication. Failed semantic-evasion and operational gates further bound the result. The evidence supports adaptive reallocation of a joint message--route code under partial monitoring, not open-world route discovery, emergent encryption, or a universal defense.

arXiv:2611.12959v1 公告类型：新
摘要：监控可见通道可以改变学习代理的通信方式，而不会消除通信的有用性。我们在端到端游戏中测试了这种区别，其中发送者和接收者在没有通信监督的情况下学习离散协议和路由策略。在两个独立的 20 粒种子批次中，形成 20/20 和 19/20 协议。与无监控相比，在线部分覆盖将影子路由份额增加了 0.701 [.574,.826] 和 0.575 [.412,.737]，而任务准确性仍为 0.905/.913，签名冻结消息贡献仍为 0.592/.563。完整的覆盖消除了大多数选择性迁移，而无需消除通信。冻结的干预措施，包括新的结果前确认，表明路线是语义的：联合消息——路线改组改变了接收者预测的 0.668，而单独路线保留了 0.388 的准确度，而机会为 0.25。修正后的显式沉默成本使 18/20 策略完全沉默，并将发送平均值降低至 0.050，但其严格的完全抑制门失败，因为两个种子保留通信。失败的语义规避和操作门进一步限制了结果。证据支持联合消息的自适应重新分配——部分监控下的路由代码，而不是开放世界的路由发现、紧急加密或通用防御。

items.title: IIT Patna at "ICPR 2026 TVRID Competition on Privacy-Preserving Person Re-Identification from Top-View RGB-Depth Camera"
items.titleZh: IIT 帕特纳参加“ICPR 2026 TVRID 隐私保护人从顶视图 RGB 深度相机重新识别竞赛”
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12960v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Privacy-aware person re-identification (Re-ID) from top-view cameras replaces frontal appearance with anthropometric shape, while depth sensing further reduces color-based identity cues. The ICPR 2026 TVRID competition evaluates this setting using 86 identities captured by four synchronized Intel RealSense D455 cameras with RGB and Depth streams across flat, ascent, descent, and oblique viewpoints. Performance is measured using mAP and CMC@1 across within-camera in/out, ascent-descent, and flat-oblique scenarios. The competition had 147 registered participants and 33 final submissions. Three teams from IIT Patna participated: 'abhinavkumar03' and 'sjkdgfhl_' ranked 5th and 7th among 31 ranked participants, and 'vivek katuri' reached 77.67% CMC@1 / 85.20% mAP on the RGB track. This paper presents the methods of the two top-10 teams. Methodology 1 (abhinavkumar03) achieves 93.51% mAP and 90.42% CMC@1 on Depth, ranking 4th of 28, while Methodology 2 (sjkdgfhl_) reaches 99.63%/99.35% on RGB and 86.26%/80.34% on Depth. Both substantially outperform the 57.19% track-average Depth mAP, with Methodology 1 yielding a 7.3-point gain over Methodology 2. These results demonstrate the importance of depth representation and supervision for privacy-preserving Re-ID.

items.title: An ensemble of graph generative models for assisted history matching of the Brugge field case
items.titleZh: 用于布鲁日现场案例辅助历史匹配的图生成模型集合
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12927v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Assisted history matching remains non-unique because many geological realisations can reproduce equivalent production responses with substantial differences between individual well matches. This ambiguity increases when a field comprises several depositional settings and modelling strategies. The paper applied a graph autoencoder approach to history matching of a benchmark Brugge field that comprises different depositional zones. Each stratigraphic zone is modelled with its dedicated generative model that comprises a joint latent space for optimisation history matching loops. Graph-based generators operate directly on the active cells of the corner-point grid, so its irregular geometry is handled without conversion to a regular lattice. The optimisation search in the 160-dimensional joint latent space is done with the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy. The multi-component objective function includes static well data mismatch, dynamic production mismatch, and a geological realism penalty based on the Decoder induced latent metric. Latent space diagnostics with topological data analysis are applied prior to history matching to test whether one generator is sufficient or whether a multiple generator formulation is required. The results show that the zone-based formulation gives coherent latent spaces, preserves the main porosity and permeability relations that vary from one zone to another, and supports history matching while keeping the solutions within the learned geological manifold. The matched models reproduce field oil and water production within the prior uncertainty range and provide a comparable well-level match to previously published Brugge studies based on Ensemble Kalman Filter, Particle Swarm Optimisation with principal component analysis of parameterisation, and Multiple Kernel Learning with Particle Swarm Optimisation.

arXiv:2611.12927v1 公告类型：新
摘要：辅助历史匹配仍然不是唯一的，因为许多地质认识可以再现等效的生产响应，但各个井匹配之间存在显着差异。当一个油田包含多个沉积环境和建模策略时，这种模糊性就会增加。该论文应用图形自动编码器方法对包含不同沉积带的基准布鲁日油田进行历史匹配。每个地层区域都使用其专用的生成模型进行建模，该模型包含用于优化历史匹配循环的联合潜在空间。基于图形的生成器直接对角点网格的活动单元进行操作，因此可以处理其不规则几何形状，而无需转换为规则网格。 160 维联合潜在空间中的优化搜索是通过协方差矩阵适应进化策略完成的。多分量目标函数包括静态井数据失配、动态生产失配以及基于解码器引起的潜在度量的地质真实性惩罚。在历史匹配之前应用带有拓扑数据分析的潜在空间诊断，以测试一个生成器是否足够或者是否需要多个生成器公式。结果表明，基于区域的公式给出了连贯的潜在空间，保留了从一个区域到另一个区域不同的主要孔隙度和渗透率关系，并支持历史匹配，同时将解决方案保持在学习的地质流形内。匹配的模型在先前的不确定性范围内再现了油田和水的生产，并提供了与先前发表的基于集成卡尔曼滤波器、具有参数化主成分分析的粒子群优化以及具有粒子群优化的多核学习的布鲁日研究的可比较的井级匹配。

arXiv:2611.12955v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Time-series classifiers deployed in risk-sensitive domains must be (1) accurate, (2) interpretable, and (3) able to abstain when evidence is weak. Existing methods do not deliver all 3 at once, and the obstacle is structural, rather than logistical. Meaningful temporal patterns cannot be defined without knowing segment boundaries, yet meaningful boundaries cannot be placed without knowing which patterns to expect. Existing approaches break this circularity by using fixed windows or expert-annotated vocabularies, thereby sacrificing at least one of the 3 properties. We introduce ConceptTime, which closes the loop through a single self-supervised signal. A frozen probabilistic forecaster predicts a distribution over the next observation at every timestep of the sequence. We call the mismatch between its prediction and the realized signal the predictive surprise. This signal both locates segment boundaries and characterizes each resulting segment through the forecaster. Segments are thus grounded by how they behaved relative to expectation, not by what they look like. These summaries cluster into a vocabulary of dynamical regimes that we call concepts. A lightweight head classifies from the concept sequence, and the distance to the nearest concept yields reliability by design. Across 17 public benchmarks, ConceptTime is competitive with state-of-the-art black-box accuracy, beats every interpretable baseline, and retains near-98% accuracy on Epilepsy with 1% of labels. It further remains competitive with softmax, prototype-distance, and SHAP/TimeX/TimeX++ on OOD detection and deletion faithfulness, without a single annotation, language model call, or domain expert. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sachithx/ConceptTime.git.

items.title: ADIndex: Layer-Adaptive Sparse Attention Indexing via Group-Level Distillation
items.titleZh: ADIndex：通过组级蒸馏进行层自适应稀疏注意力索引
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12956v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) reduces the computational cost of attention through token-level selection. However, its indexer still scores the entire causal prefix for each query, making indexing a dominant source of latency in long-context inference. Notably, the indexer alone can account for more than 50% of total prefill GPU time at long context lengths. To address this bottleneck, we propose ADIndex, an Adaptive and Distillation-driven Indexing method for token-level sparse attention. ADIndex integrates three key components: (i) a layer-wise calibration strategy that adaptively accommodates cross-query retrieval overlap, motivated by our observation of pronounced inter-layer heterogeneity; (ii) a group-level distillation scheme that leverages this heterogeneity to efficiently train adaptive layer-wise group indexers, capturing salient retrieval signals from individual queries; and (iii) a low-latency inference strategy that reduces repeated full-prefix scans through token bank sharing within query groups while retaining query-specific refinement. Experiments on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 demonstrate that ADIndex preserves near-lossless task performance on LongBench, LongBench v2, and RULER while delivering substantial efficiency gains over standard DSA, including prefill and decoding kernel speedups of up to 6.22x and 3.40x, respectively, at a context length of 256K across the layer-wise reuse configurations, as well as an end-to-end serving speedup of 1.54x at a context length of 128K.

arXiv:2611.12956v1 公告类型：新
摘要：DeepSeek 稀疏注意力（DSA）通过 token 级别的选择降低了注意力的计算成本。然而，它的索引器仍然对每个查询的整个因果前缀进行评分，使得索引成为长上下文推理中延迟的主要来源。值得注意的是，在长上下文长度下，仅索引器就可以占总预填充 GPU 时间的 50% 以上。为了解决这个瓶颈，我们提出了 ADIndex，一种用于令牌级稀疏注意力的自适应和蒸馏驱动的索引方法。 ADIndex 集成了三个关键组件：（i）分层校准策略，该策略自适应地适应跨查询检索重叠，其动机是我们对明显的层间异质性的观察； (ii) 一种组级蒸馏方案，利用这种异质性来有效地训练自适应分层组索引器，从各个查询中捕获显着的检索信号； (iii) 低延迟推理策略，通过查询组内的令牌库共享来减少重复的全前缀扫描，同时保留特定于查询的细化。 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5.1 上的实验表明，ADIndex 在 LongBench、LongBench v2 和 RULER 上保留了近乎无损的任务性能，同时比标准 DSA 提供了显着的效率提升，包括在跨分层重用配置的上下文长度为 256K 时，预填充和解码内核加速分别高达 6.22 倍和 3.40 倍，以及端到端服务加速上下文长度为 128K 时为 1.54 倍。

items.title: Exploration via Exploitation: The Blessing of Reward Diversity in Personalized Federated RL
items.titleZh: 通过利用进行探索：个性化联邦强化学习中奖励多样性的祝福
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12964v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: While federated reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally guaranteed high efficiency in homogeneous environments, collaboration is often hindered when agents possess distinct goals. In this paper, we flip this paradigm, framing reward heterogeneity not as a hurdle to consensus, but as a structural asset that catalyzes exploration. We first propose Personalized Federated Upper Confidence Bound Value Iteration (PF-UCBVI), which achieves optimal linear speedup by decoupling shared dynamics from personalized objectives. To eliminate the risks of explicit exploration, we then introduce Personalized Federated Exploration-Free Value Iteration (PF-EFVI), a purely greedy algorithm that leverages reward diversity to ensure state-action coverage. We prove that PF-EFVI attains logarithmic regret without explicit exploration bonuses under sufficient reward diversity. Our results reveal that agent disagreement shifts the exploration burden from temporal complexity to spatial diversity, enabling efficient collective learning without explicit exploration.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.12964v1 公告类型：新
摘要：虽然联邦强化学习（RL）传统上保证了同质环境中的高效率，但当智能体拥有不同的目标时，协作往往会受到阻碍。在本文中，我们翻转了这种范式，将奖励异质性视为一种促进探索的结构性资产，而不是达成共识的障碍。我们首先提出个性化联合上置信界值迭代（PF-UCBVI），它通过将共享动态与个性化目标解耦来实现最佳线性加速。为了消除显式探索的风险，我们引入了个性化联邦无探索价值迭代（PF-EFVI），这是一种纯粹的贪婪算法，利用奖励多样性来确保状态动作覆盖。我们证明，在足够的奖励多样性下，PF-EFVI 在没有明确的探索奖励的情况下获得了对数遗憾。我们的结果表明，代理分歧将探索负担从时间复杂性转移到空间多样性，从而无需明确的探索即可实现高效的集体学习。

items.title: StatPrompt-LLM: A Lightweight Statistical Refinement for Foundation-Style Time-Series Forecasting
items.titleZh: StatPrompt-LLM：基础型时间序列预测的轻量级统计细化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12974v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Time-series forecasting has recently seen a paradigm shift with the introduction of foundation-style models that adapt large pretrained language architectures to sequential data. However, effectively exposing fundamental temporal structures, such as trend, scale, and temporal dependence, to these models remains an open challenge, particularly when the available observations are limited. In this paper, we conduct an exploratory empirical study across different generations of forecasting architectures and propose StatPrompt-LLM, a lightweight statistical refinement of Time-LLM. StatPrompt-LLM augments the existing Time-LLM prompting mechanism with dataset-level statistical information and introduces a zero-initialised autoregressive bypass as a complementary linear forecasting pathway. We evaluate our framework on electricity and meteorological time-series benchmarks, including ETTh1, ETTh2, and Weather, under full-prefix and reduced-prefix configurations. Under the 10% reduced-prefix configuration, StatPrompt-LLM achieved lower in-sample prediction errors than Time-LLM, with unweighted average relative reductions across datasets of 40.2% in MSE and 21.4% in MAE. Full-prefix results were more dataset-dependent. Ablation analyses revealed relatively modest and dataset-dependent changes when selected additional statistical descriptor groups were masked within the combined architecture. Computational profiling indicated additional model parameters and runtime overhead relative to Time-LLM.

arXiv:2611.12974v1 公告类型：新
摘要：随着基础型模型的引入，时间序列预测最近发生了范式转变，这些模型使大型预训练语言架构适应序列数据。然而，有效地将基本时间结构（例如趋势、规模和时间依赖性）暴露给这些模型仍然是一个开放的挑战，特别是当可用的观察有限时。在本文中，我们对不同代的预测架构进行了探索性实证研究，并提出了 StatPrompt-LLM，一种 Time-LLM 的轻量级统计细化。 StatPrompt-LLM 通过数据集级统计信息增强了现有的 Time-LLM 提示机制，并引入了零初始化自回归旁路作为补充线性预测路径。我们在全前缀和缩减前缀配置下评估我们的电力和气象时间序列基准框架，包括 ETTh1、ETTh2 和天气。在减少 10% 的前缀配置下，StatPrompt-LLM 实现了比 Time-LLM 更低的样本内预测误差，跨数据集的未加权平均相对减少量在 MSE 中为 40.2%，在 MAE 中为 21.4%。完整前缀结果更依赖于数据集。当选定的附加统计描述符组被隐藏在组合架构中时，消融分析揭示了相对适度且依赖于数据集的变化。计算分析表明相对于 Time-LLM 存在额外的模型参数和运行时开销。

items.title: MADSNet: A Multi-Scale Axial-Attentive Dense Spiking Network for Spike Camera Image Reconstruction
items.titleZh: MADSNet：用于尖峰相机图像重建的多尺度轴向注意密集尖峰网络
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12980v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Spike cameras encode dynamic scenes into high-temporal-resolution binary spike streams for efficient high-speed vision. Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process such signals with sparse and accumulate-only computation, existing SNN-based reconstruction methods are typically shallow and still lag behind ANN-based models in reconstruction fidelity. This paper proposes MADSNet, a Multi-scale Axial-attentive Dense Spiking Network for spike camera image reconstruction. MADSNet adopts a hierarchical spiking encoder--decoder, where a multi-scale spike stem extracts early features, axial spike attention captures long-range dependencies, a dense spiking bottleneck enhances feature reuse, and a spike-to-continuous decoder reconstructs continuous intensity images from spike-domain representations. Experiments on gray-scale and color spike reconstruction show that MADSNet outperforms SSIR by 4.3 dB PSNR and Spk2ImgNet by 1.94 dB on SREDS. Compared with Spk2ImgNet, it achieves about 15$\times$ lower latency and uses only about 1/40 of the estimated energy, demonstrating that carefully designed SNN architectures can improve reconstruction quality while preserving computational efficiency.

items.title: Third Eye: Beyond Immediate Gains in Recursive Self-Improvement
items.titleZh: 第三只眼：超越递归自我完善的即时收益
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12988v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Does a useful self-update remain useful after the model updates again? Third Eye separates immediate performance from the outcome of a further native update. We evaluate five 3-8B backbones on math and code: 64 fresh runs, three candidates per run, and three continuations per candidate. Selection and final scoring use disjoint items. In the balanced Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B comparison, immediate-selected utility is near zero, but continuation reduces it by 1.78 percentage points (simultaneous 95% interval [0.68, 2.88]). Candidate-averaged immediate utility is already negative: selection partly accounts for the apparently neutral first step. Continuation also lowers utility for SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.1-8B; Qwen3-8B remains inconclusive. Target and out-of-distribution losses dominate retention changes. Matched recipe and recipient-donor controls identify neither a reliable mitigation nor a single mechanism. The results support evaluating persistent self-updates as adaptation transitions, with independent scoring and a no-update baseline, rather than interpreting immediate performance as their full value.

arXiv:2611.12988v1 公告类型：新
摘要：有用的自我更新在模型再次更新后仍然有用吗？第三眼将即时性能与进一步本机更新的结果分开。我们评估了数学和代码方面的 5 个 3-8B 主干：64 次新运行，每次运行 3 个候选，每个候选 3 个延续。选择和最终评分使用不相交的项目。在平衡的 Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B 比较中，立即选择效用接近于零，但延续将其降低了 1.78 个百分点（同时 95% 区间 [0.68, 2.88]）。候选人的平均即时效用已经为负：选择在一定程度上解释了看似中性的第一步。延续也会降低 SmolLM3-3B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 的效用； Qwen3-8B 仍无定论。目标损失和分配外损失主导保留变化。匹配的配方和接受者-捐赠者控制既不能识别可靠的缓解措施，也不能识别单一机制。结果支持将持续的自我更新评估为适应过渡，并具有独立评分和无更新基线，而不是将即时表现解释为其全部价值。

items.title: Multimodal Graph Learning: A Survey of Models, Benchmarks, and Frontiers
items.titleZh: 多模态图学习：模型、基准和前沿的调查
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12990v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs), in which nodes carry text, images, and other modalities while edges encode relations among entities, underlie e-commerce, social media, content platforms, and creative applications. Learning on MAGs has developed along two complementary lines: graph-centric methods redesign how modalities are fused, propagated, and connected within message passing, while foundation-model-centric methods pretrain transferable multimodal graph encoders or bring graph context into multimodal large language models for prediction and generation. In parallel, several benchmarks have appeared with different datasets and evaluation protocols. This survey takes an algorithm-centric and evaluation-grounded view of the field and makes three contributions. Modeling: we introduce a unified message-passing formulation and organize methods into five integration levels (feature, propagation, topology, learning, and foundation model), covering discriminative and graph-conditioned generative models; within this formulation we derive representative methods as special cases, compare their assumptions, expressiveness, and cost, and identify cross-modal sensitivity as a property that separates otherwise similar architectures. Datasets and evaluation: we review recent benchmarks, summarize their datasets and metrics, define model-independent descriptors (label homophily, average degree, clustering, and edge provenance), and map each evaluation protocol to the baselines it uses. Frontiers: we connect multimodal graph learning to AI agents, covering the multimodal graphs that agents perceive and remember and graph engineering, the practice of organizing agent workflows as explicit graphs; we then discuss open problems, concrete efforts for the community, and research directions, including when graph structure helps in the presence of strong multimodal foundation models.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.12990v1 公告类型：新
摘要：多模态属性图（MAG）是电子商务、社交媒体、内容平台和创意应用程序的基础，其中节点承载文本、图像和其他模态，而边编码实体之间的关系。 MAG 的学习沿着两条互补的路线发展：以图为中心的方法重新设计了消息传递中模态的融合、传播和连接方式，而以基础模型为中心的方法预训练可转移的多模态图编码器或将图上下文引入多模态大语言模型中以进行预测和生成。与此同时，出现了几个具有不同数据集和评估协议的基准。这项调查采用了以算法为中心、以评估为基础的领域观点，并做出了三点贡献。建模：我们引入了统一的消息传递公式，并将方法组织为五个集成级别（特征、传播、拓扑、学习和基础模型），涵盖判别模型和图条件生成模型；在此公式中，我们将代表性方法作为特殊情况得出，比较它们的假设、表达能力和成本，并将跨模式敏感性识别为区分其他类似架构的属性。数据集和评估：我们回顾最近的基准，总结其数据集和指标，定义与模型无关的描述符（标签同质性、平均程度、聚类和边缘来源），并将每个评估协议映射到它使用的基线。前沿：我们将多模态图学习与人工智能代理联系起来，涵盖代理感知和记忆的多模态图以及图工程，将代理工作流程组织为显式图的实践；然后，我们讨论开放问题、社区的具体努力和研究方向，包括图结构在强大的多模态基础模型中何时有所帮助。

items.title: Linear Probes to Bayesian Manifolds: Geometry of Arithmetic in Large Language Models
items.titleZh: 贝叶斯流形的线性探测：大型语言模型中的算术几何
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.12998v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Linear probes are a standard method to study geometric structures, such as helices and circles, from the activations of large language models (LLMs), and such structure is often taken as evidence that the model computes with it. Probe accuracy alone cannot establish this, because it conflates four separate claims. These are (1) that the concept is decodable from the activations, (2) that they form a specific shape, (3) that the shape belongs to the probed concept rather than to a related concept the model also represents, and (4) that the output of the model depends on the shape. We call these claims decodability, shape, ownership, and causal use, and we test them separately with a four-stage Bayesian pipeline. Stage 2 compares candidate shapes and selects the best one only when its evidence passes a predefined threshold. Stage 3 removes a set of related concepts, specified in advance, and tests whether the shape is owned or inherited. Stage 4 intervenes on the shape to test whether the output of the model depends on it. We apply the pipeline to two-digit addition and multiplication in GPT-J 6B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Pythia 6.9B. Nearly every concept is decodable, but the decoded directions overlap substantially across concepts. Every strongly supported comparison selects a ribbon, which is a helix whose radius changes with the value, or a torus. Of 1,330 cells with an ownership verdict, 19% of shapes are owned and 81% are inherited. Owned and inherited shapes move the output about equally often. Intervening on the shape retains approximately 61% of the effect of intervening on the full probe while using at most five dimensions, against a median of nine for the probe. Our results indicate that a probe verdict alone overstates what a model computes with, and we propose that probe results be reported as verdicts on all four claims rather than as a single accuracy.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.12998v1 公告类型：新
摘要：线性探针是从大型语言模型（LLM）的激活中研究螺旋和圆等几何结构的标准方法，这种结构通常被视为模型用它进行计算的证据。仅靠探头精度无法证明这一点，因为它合并了四个不同的主张。这些是（1）概念可以从激活中解码，（2）它们形成特定的形状，（3）该形状属于探测的概念而不是模型也表示的相关概念，以及（4）模型的输出取决于形状。我们将这些声明称为可解码性、形状、所有权和因果使用，并使用四阶段贝叶斯管道单独测试它们。第 2 阶段比较候选形状，仅当其证据通过预定义阈值时才选择最佳形状。第 3 阶段删除一组预先指定的相关概念，并测试该形状是否是拥有的或继承的。第 4 阶段对形状进行干预，以测试模型的输出是否依赖于它。我们将该管道应用于 GPT-J 6B、Llama 3.1 8B 和 Pythia 6.9B 中的两位数加法和乘法。几乎每个概念都是可解码的，但解码的方向在概念之间基本上重叠。每个强支持的比较都会选择一条带（其半径随值而变化的螺旋）或一个环面。在 1,330 个拥有所有权判决的单元中，19% 的形状是拥有的，81% 是继承的。自有形状和继承形状移动输出的频率大致相同。在最多使用五个维度时，对形状进行干预保留了对整个探针进行干预的大约 61% 的效果，而探针的中位数为 9 个。我们的结果表明，单独的探测判决夸大了模型的计算结果，我们建议将探测结果报告为对所有四个主张的判决，而不是单一的准确性。
items.author: Anshul Kumar, Neha Prasad, Manoj Kumar, Barnab\'as P\'oczos, Deeksha Varshney

items.title: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
items.titleZh: 一张表，许多查询：跨生成、插补和预测的通用表格模型基准测试
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.13001v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. This leaves unclear which capabilities they share, how their training objectives interact, and whether one model can perform all three well. We introduce the One Table Benchmark (\ours{}), spanning 56 datasets, 46 registered methods, and 20 capability axes under aligned data splits and explicit task contracts. We compare task ranks on aligned support, train five backbones under all seven non-empty objective combinations on five datasets with three seeds, and contrast fixed-model profiles with specialist portfolios. Rank comparisons connect imputation and prediction through numerical recovery and dependence preservation, and link generation to both through predictive utility; distributional fidelity follows different, sometimes opposing, rankings. Objective interventions show the largest pooled gains from including the recipient's own objective. Generation has the broadest coverage of positive pooled auxiliary effects, while prediction shows potential to improve imputation and synthetic-data utility, with responses that vary across backbones. Cross-addition effects reveal that objective benefits need not add and depend on the objectives already present. Fixed-model comparisons expose corresponding utility--fidelity trade-offs: some generalists surpass specialist portfolios on utility, while fidelity continues to favor specialization. Frozen foundation models show strong prediction and numerical point imputation, together with promising synthetic-data utility, highlighting their potential across all three tasks. These findings motivate unified tabular models that share useful conditional information while improving categorical reconstruction and faithful joint sampling.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.13001v1 公告类型：新
摘要：生成、插补和预测查询同一表格分布的不同方面，但通常单独评估。这使得我们不清楚它们共享哪些功能、它们的训练目标如何相互作用，以及一个模型是否可以很好地执行这三项功能。我们引入了单表基准（\ours{}），涵盖 56 个数据集、46 个注册方法以及对齐数据分割和显式任务契约下的 20 个功能轴。我们比较对齐支持上的任务排名，在具有三个种子的五个数据集上的所有七个非空目标组合下训练五个主干，并将固定模型配置文件与专家组合进行对比。排名比较通过数值恢复和依赖性保留将插补和预测联系起来，并通过预测效用将生成与两者联系起来；分布保真度遵循不同的、有时是相反的排名。客观干预显示，将接受者自己的目标纳入其中可以带来最大的综合收益。生成具有最广泛的积极汇总辅助效应，而预测则显示出改善插补和合成数据效用的潜力，不同骨干网的响应各不相同。交叉相加效应表明，客观收益不需要相加，而是取决于已经存在的目标。固定模型比较揭示了相应的效用-保真度权衡：一些通才在效用方面超越了专业投资组合，而保真度继续有利于专业化。冻结基础模型显示出强大的预测和数值点插补，以及有前途的合成数据实用性，突出了它们在所有三项任务中的潜力。这些发现激发了统一的表格模型，这些模型共享有用的条件信息，同时改进分类重建和忠实联合采样。
items.author: Yuanrui Wang, Kaifang Li, Xuanyue Li, Ziyun Li, Yan Lu, Xingxuan Zhang, Peng Cui

items.title: Branch-and-Commit for Frozen RL Agents: When and Where to Spend Test-Time Compute
items.titleZh: 冻结 RL 代理的分支和提交：何时何地进行测试计算
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.13003v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents are often deployed with policies that cannot be retrained or modified. In digital environments whose states can be copied and resumed, an operator has another option: sample several continuations from the current state, evaluate them, and continue from the endpoint of the selected branch. We call this procedure branch-and-commit. We study when it improves return, what produces the improvement, and where its computational budget should be spent. Across four environments, two frozen policies, five continuation verifiers, and a model-free selection rule, we find that the benefit of branching depends on dispersion: the difference between the best candidate return and the mean candidate return. Branching provides no benefit in low-dispersion settings, while increasing return by 12.8% in our main Craftax-Medium setting. Most of this gain comes not from selecting better actions, but from selecting among different stochastic realizations of the same action. Several competent verifiers achieve similar episode returns, suggesting that verifier quality is not the main constraint at our operating budget. Instead, computation is better allocated to states where useful dispersion is likely. On held-out seeds, gating branching using predicted dispersion retains 69% of the improvement from uniform branching while using 48% as many branching calls. These results characterize when branch-and-commit is useful and clarify what its gains represent.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.13003v1 公告类型：新
摘要：强化学习代理通常部署有无法重新训练或修改的策略。在状态可以复制和恢复的数字环境中，操作员还有另一种选择：从当前状态采样多个延续，对其进行评估，然后从所选分支的端点继续。我们将此过程称为分支提交。我们研究什么时候它会提高回报，什么会带来改善，以及它的计算预算应该花在哪里。在四个环境、两个冻结策略、五个连续验证器和一个无模型选择规则中，我们发现分支的好处取决于分散性：最佳候选回报与平均候选回报之间的差异。支化在低分散设置中没有任何好处，而在我们的主要 Craftax-Medium 设置中却将回报增加了 12.8%。这种收益大部分不是来自选择更好的行动，而是来自同一行动的不同随机实现中的选择。几个有能力的验证者获得了类似的事件回报，这表明验证者的质量并不是我们运营预算的主要限制。相反，计算最好分配给可能有用分散的状态。对于保留的种子，使用预测分散进行门控分支保留了均匀分支的 69% 的改进，同时使用了 48% 的分支调用。这些结果描述了分支提交何时有用，并阐明了其收益代表什么。
items.author: Sahar Admoni, Assaf Hallak, Yftah Ziser, Ofra Amir

items.title: The Shape of a Program: Path Signatures for Trace-to-Program Induction
items.titleZh: 程序的形状：跟踪到程序归纳的路径签名
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.13005v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Synthesizing programs from execution traces is a fundamental challenge in algorithmic interpretability and the reverse engineering of complex systems. We bring a rough-path-theoretic perspective to program induction, treating execution traces as high-dimensional rough paths and encoding them with the path signature transform, a tool from stochastic analysis whose expectation provably characterizes the distribution of traces a program induces. On three program-induction domains, Karel, List, and RASP, our log-signature trace encoder outperforms LSTM, Transformer, and Fourier baselines in almost every setting, with its largest margins when training data is scarce. We further observe that the trace-to-program pipeline is naturally contractive: it often produces valid programs that are shorter than the ground truth. We turn this into a bootstrapping procedure that exposes redundancy in the ground-truth supervision without any external oracle, which we demonstrate on redundancy-injected versions of our datasets. Finally, the log-signature encoder induces a markedly more interpretable latent geometry than the baselines, in which the nearest neighbors of every state lie on its own execution trace.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.13005v1 公告类型：新
摘要：从执行轨迹合成程序是算法可解释性和复杂系统逆向工程的基本挑战。我们为程序归纳带来了粗糙路径理论的视角，将执行轨迹视为高维粗糙路径，并使用路径签名变换对其进行编码，路径签名变换是一种来自随机分析的工具，其期望可证明表征程序归纳的轨迹的分布。在三个程序归纳领域（Karel、List 和 RASP）上，我们的日志签名跟踪编码器几乎在所有设置中都优于 LSTM、Transformer 和 Fourier 基线，并且在训练数据稀缺时具有最大的优势。我们进一步观察到，从跟踪到程序的管道自然是收缩的：它通常会生成比真实值更短的有效程序。我们将其转变为一个引导程序，无需任何外部预言机即可暴露真实监督中的冗余，我们在数据集的冗余注入版本上进行了演示。最后，日志签名编码器产生比基线更可解释的潜在几何结构，其中每个状态的最近邻居位于其自己的执行轨迹上。
items.author: Mohamed Ghanem, Bernd Finkbeiner

items.title: FaST: Factored Synthesis of Transitions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
items.titleZh: FaST：离线强化学习的转换分解合成
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.13013v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Synthetic data augmentation promises to scale offline reinforcement learning beyond fixed logged datasets, but leading diffusion-based generators model the transition tuple (state, action, next state, reward, terminal) as a monolith: no single factor can be natively redrawn in isolation. We present FaST (Factored Synthesis of Transitions), which factors transitions via the chain rule into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, fitting each with an estimator matched to its statistical properties. Across twelve D4RL locomotion and maze benchmarks, TD3+BC and IQL agents trained on FaST transitions match the SynthER diffusion baseline while generating transitions over 90x faster. The explicit action-given-state conditional can also be re-queried for a fixed state, enabling targeted action synthesis: drawing N candidate actions per generated state and keeping the highest-advantage one under a value function fit to the same data, thereby synthesizing improved behavior during generation rather than filtering for it post-hoc. Best-of-10 synthesis beats training on real data on 11 of 12 medium and medium-replay settings (+8.9 D4RL points on average, up to +28.4), and is competitive with advantage-filtered SynthER at a fraction of its generation cost. On expert mixtures both mechanisms degrade identically, tracing the failure to the advantage estimate itself rather than to either targeting mechanism.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.13013v1 公告类型：新
摘要：合成数据增强有望将离线强化学习扩展到固定的记录数据集之外，但领先的基于扩散的生成器将转换元组（状态、动作、下一个状态、奖励、终端）建模为一个整体：没有任何单个因素可以单独地本地重绘。我们提出了 FaST（转换的分解综合），它通过链式法则将转换分解为状态、动作、动态、奖励和最终阶段，并为每个阶段配备与其统计属性相匹配的估计器。在 12 个 D4RL 运动和迷宫基准中，经过 FaST 转换训练的 TD3+BC 和 IQL 代理与 SynthER 扩散基线相匹配，同时生成转换的速度快了 90 倍以上。显式给定动作状态条件也可以重新查询固定状态，从而实现有针对性的动作合成：为每个生成的状态绘制 N 个候选动作，并在适合相同数据的值函数下保留最高优势的动作，从而在生成过程中综合改进的行为，而不是事后过滤。 Best-of-10 合成击败了在 12 个中等和中等重放设置中的 11 个上对真实数据进行的训练（平均 +8.9 D4RL 点，高达 +28.4），并且与优势过滤的 SynthER 相比，其生成成本仅为其一小部分。在专家混合中，两种机制的退化相同，将失败归因于优势估计本身，而不是任一目标机制。

items.title: Permutation-Based Pre-trained Model Merging via Reciprocal Orthogonality
items.titleZh: 通过相互正交性进行基于排列的预训练模型合并
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.13016v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Ito et al. (2026) showed that sufficiently wide, independently trained neural networks can exhibit linear mode connectivity (LMC) with softmax temperature calibration, even without permutation. LMC means that a low-loss linear path connects the models' parameters. This behavior is explained by layerwise exponentially weighted connectivity (LEWC), whereby each merged layer outputs an exponentially weighted sum of the original models' corresponding representations, yielding ensemble-like predictions. However, prior work observed LEWC with substantial widening, such as 8192 units per hidden layer for MLPs and $16\times$ width for VGG-11, raising the question of whether such widths are necessary. We therefore search for permutations that encourage reciprocal orthogonality (RO), which suppresses interference between each model's weights and the other model's representations. This allows both models' computations to coexist in the merged network, promoting LEWC at smaller widths. We formulate the search as independent layerwise quadratic assignment problems and approximately solve their continuous relaxations using Frank--Wolfe. Experiments show that our method facilitates LMC with less width expansion. It also merges models trained on different data distributions, where weight matching, which maximizes weight similarity through permutations, struggles. The merged predictions approximate those of a logit ensemble of the original models.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.13016v1 公告类型：新
摘要：伊藤等人。 (2026) 表明，足够宽、独立训练的神经网络即使没有排列，也可以通过 softmax 温度校准表现出线性模式连接 (LMC)。 LMC 意味着低损耗线性路径连接模型的参数。这种行为可以通过分层指数加权连接（LEWC）来解释，其中每个合并层输出原始模型相应表示的指数加权和，从而产生类似集成的预测。然而，之前的工作观察到 LEWC 具有显着的加宽，例如 MLP 每个隐藏层有 8192 个单元，VGG-11 的宽度为 16\times$，这就提出了这样的宽度是否必要的问题。因此，我们寻找鼓励相互正交性（RO）的排列，从而抑制每个模型的权重与另一个模型的表示之间的干扰。这允许两个模型的计算在合并网络中共存，从而以更小的宽度提升 LEWC。我们将搜索表述为独立的分层二次分配问题，并使用 Frank-Wolfe 近似求解它们的连续松弛。实验表明，我们的方法有利于 LMC 的宽度扩展较小。它还合并了在不同数据分布上训练的模型，其中通过排列最大化权重相似性的权重匹配却很困难。合并的预测近似于原始模型的 Logit 集合的预测。
items.author: Akira Ito, Daiki Chijiwa, Atsutoshi Kumagai

items.title: Explanation-Aware Fairness Beyond Output Parity: Joint Output-Attribution Regularization for Medical Image Classification
items.titleZh: 超越输出奇偶性的解释感知公平性：医学图像分类的联合输出属性正则化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.13052v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Output-level fairness does not constrain whether demographic groups rely on similar predictive contributions in representation space. For a nonlinear encoder with a linear head, we show that outcome-conditioned output score disparity equals the signed sum of feature attribution differences across subgroups by allowing small prediction gaps to arise through cancellation effect. We test whether an attribution disparity penalty complements output-level equalized odds based fairness surrogates. Across 960 DINOv2-LoRA models on HAM10000 and Harvard-GF datasets for gender and race fairness, attribution augmentation increases utility-fairness trade-off performance for hypervolume in six different settings with paired 95% confidence intervals and relative gains of 1.49-10.57%. Under a predefined utility constraint, augmented model families also achieve 9.0-38.7% lower equalized odds difference, lower attribution disparity, and reduced cancellation ratio while preserving predictive utility. These results support attribution fairness as a complementary explanation-aware constraint on output fairness.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.13052v1 公告类型：新
摘要：产出水平的公平性并不限制人口群体是否依赖于代表性空间中的类似预测贡献。对于具有线性头的非线性编码器，我们通过允许通过抵消效应产生小的预测间隙，表明结果条件输出分数差异等于子组之间特征属性差异的有符号和。我们测试归因差异惩罚是否补充了基于公平替代的产出水平均等赔率。在用于性别和种族公平的 HAM10000 和Harvard-GF 数据集上的 960 个 DINOv2-LoRA 模型中，归因增强在六种不同设置中提高了超容量的效用公平权衡性能，配对的置信区间为 95%，相对增益为 1.49-10.57%。在预定义的效用约束下，增强模型系列还可以将均衡比值差异降低 9.0-38.7%、降低归因差异并降低取消率，同时保留预测效用。这些结果支持归因公平性作为对输出公平性的补充解释感知约束。
